The spec tables have no Listings column; the page-footer listing marks are cETLus (Intertek), FCC and DLC Listed

Beam angle and operating temp icons are split by family: 120° and -4°F to 140°F for DOT / DRD / SCD, 160° and -4°F to 113°F for DAL

No photo of the Sconce (SCD) appears on this spread
Printed page number 42 appears on the left-hand page only; the right-hand page carries no printed number (43 inferred)
